name: explorar.dev
description: A source code exploration and navigation platform

scripts.guides:validate: npm run guides:generate && npm run lint:markdown && tsx scripts/validate-guides.ts && tsx scripts/check-guide-refs.ts
scripts.predev: npm run guides:generate && tsx scripts/download-repos.ts --only=apple-oss-distributions/xnu --only=freebsd/freebsd-src --only=ghostbsd/ghostbsd-src --only=nextbsd-redux/nextbsd-kernel --only=reactos/reactos --only=python/cpython --only=torvalds/linux --only=littlekernel/lk --only=mrcxlinux/srv03rtm-anika --depth=1 && tsx scripts/build-man-pages.ts && tsx scripts/prepare-public-assets.ts --dev --sqljs
scripts.clean: rm -rf repos man-pages public/repos public/man-pages public/sqljs public/public-stage-manifest.json out node_modules .next .eslintcache
scripts.lint: npm run lint:types && npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:prettier && npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:deps
scripts.fix: npm run fix:eslint && npm run fix:prettier && npm run lint:types
scripts.test:sanity: npm run prepare:sqljs && playwright test tests/sanity.spec.ts
scripts.test:performance: npm run prepare:sqljs && playwright test tests/web-vitals.spec.ts
scripts.test:seo: npm run prepare:sqljs && playwright test tests/seo.spec.ts
scripts.test:quality: npm run prepare:sqljs && playwright test tests/quality.spec.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:report
